explication: JMComic is a Python API and downloader for retrieving comic albums, chapters, and processed images from JMComic’s web and mobile interfaces. The main workflow is initiated through the Python API or CLI, configured by an Option, then executed by a synchronous or asynchronous downloader using a client. Clients also expose documented search, account, comments, ranking, and favorites capabilities. Entities, shared toolkit utilities, task context, and plugins/features support the runtime. Some feature links are documented only at the product level; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
